item.title: RimWorld Pawn Planner — Build Your Starting Colonists
item.description: Use the RimWorld pawn planner to design your starting colonists. Set skill levels, pick up to two traits, and see your build instantly — built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Pawn Planner Step 1 — Choose your skills Shooting 5 Melee 5 Construction 5 Mining 5 Cooking 5 Plants 5 Animals 5 Crafting 5 Artistic 5 Medical 5 Social 5 Intellectual 5 Step 2 — Pick up to 2 traits Sanguine (best) Industrious (best) Too Smart (best) Brawler (good) Jogger (good) Night Owl (good) Quick Sleeper (good) Tough (good) Abrasive (bad) Greedy (bad) Jealous (bad) Too Slow (bad) Pyromaniac (worst) Chemical Interest (worst) Wimp (worst) Lazy (worst) Step 3 — Your pawn build Selected traits Strongest skills What Makes a Good Starting Colonist?
